detail: loadConfig's deepMerge only copies keys present in the TARGET (DEFAULT_CONFIG), so removing the default key would silently drop a user's explicit storage.backend, and a loadConfig-signature side-channel for explicitness would churn every caller. The "auto" sentinel survives the merge, keeps explicit files/sqlite pins working unchanged, and localizes the resolution rule in src/storage/backend-resolve.ts with the ambiguity rule: anything unreadable/malformed counts as legacy content so misdetection lands on files (safe), never an empty database.
summary: Implemented the v2 default backend flip as an "auto" sentinel in DEFAULT_CONFIG resolved at createStores time, not a blind default change
